history.summary: Large 1,356 sqft 3BR in a well-regarded 642-unit Pasir Ris condo priced at PSF 1386 — a ~2% discount to the URA median of 1414 — with 7.3%/yr resale CAGR on a deep 178-txn base and a $1.88M quantum in the deepest buyer band. CP1 Pasir Ris MRT will become a Cross Island Line interchange beside the new Pasir Ris Mall integrated hub — a clean Buy.
history.rating_rationale: Good all-round value: PSF 1386 is slightly below the URA median, the 1,356 sqft layout is genuinely large for families, and $1.88M sits squarely in the deepest buyer band for easy exit. 7.3%/yr resale CAGR on 178 transactions is reliable, and reviews are strongly positive (4.5/5, spacious units, good maintenance, quiet). The real catalyst is CP1 Pasir Ris becoming a Cross Island Line interchange (~2030) anchored by the new Pasir Ris 8 / Pasir Ris Mall integrated development next door, which is lifting the whole micro-market. 670m walk is moderate but acceptable. Few material flaws.
red_flags: 670m / 8-min walk to MRT — moderate, not doorstep

history.summary: Large 1,356 sqft 3BR in a 642-unit Pasir Ris (D18/OCR) condo at $1,386 psf, fairly priced within the verified recent range and backed by a dated Cross Island Line 2030 catalyst.
history.rating_rationale: Asking $1,386 psf sits comfortably inside the verified last-12-month transaction band ($1,106-$1,532 psf, avg ~$1,329) on deep data (178 appreciation txns), so the dossier's age_adj_premium of -5.6% reflects a real, mild discount rather than a thin-cohort quirk. OCR is the strongest forward region in the v3.4 backtest (~+4.0% realized fwd), and the location has a decisive physical catalyst: Pasir Ris becomes a Cross Island Line interchange in 2030 plus an integrated mall/bus-interchange/residential development next door. 3.6% project rental yield is OCR-typical. A large 3BR floorplate also supports own-stay/family resale demand. The 7.27% trailing CAGR is story only (v3.4: ~0 forward power). Main reservations: $1.88M quantum and $1,386 psf is at the upper-middle of the range, so entry price is not a steal, and the 2008-vintage 99-LH has ~81 years left.
red_flags: Asking psf ($1,386) is at the upper-middle of the recent band, not a deep discount
Trailing 7.27% CAGR carries ~0 forward predictive power; do not extrapolate
$1.88M quantum is sizeable for OCR Pasir Ris, narrowing the buyer pool
catalysts: Pasir Ris Cross Island Line interchange opening 2030 (CRL Punggol branch by 2032)
Integrated mixed-use development (mall, bus interchange, residences) next to Pasir Ris MRT
Large family-sized 3BR supports own-stay resale demand in a maturing estate
